recommendation: Keep this source fix as the FHIR-47737 reconciliation. It aligns the authoritative current source and active example with the applied WG decision; FHIR-53690 can be closed or otherwise handled separately only after normal WG disposition.
issue_request: FHIR-47737 was Applied as Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core Requirements. The final disposition changed Requirements.actor from a canonical to a backbone with key 1..1 id and reference 1..1 canonical, added Requirements.statement.actor 0..* id values referencing actor keys, added an invariant requiring statement actors to match Requirements.actor.key, and updated the actor comment for per-statement relevance.
initial_application: Commit 88c7b5ba applied the actor/reference/statement.actor model and constraints, but it set Requirements.actor.key to 0..1 and left Requirements-example2 with an actor that had no key. No prior Issue-Reconcile-Key commit for FHIR-47737 existed on the combined branch before this reconciliation.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes from 2024-10-28 confirm the actor key 1..1 disposition and clarify that a mistaken reopen discussion did not alter FHIR-47737. Requirements is active in source/fhir.ini, and fhir.ini records Requirements.actor.key, Requirements.actor.reference, and Requirements.statement.actor as R5/R6 changes. FHIR-53690 later raised the optional actor key as a ballot concern, but it remains Triaged/unresolved and was not decided separately.
reconciliation: Changed source/requirements/structuredefinition-Requirements.xml so Requirements.actor.key has min 1, and added a key to the actor in source/requirements/Requirements-example2.xml. Generated diagram/SVG artifacts were not manually edited.
source_changes: source/requirements/Requirements-example2.xml: added key a1 to the actor backbone so the example remains valid.
